title: Outlook: declarative agents in Copilot Chat in classic Outlook for Windows
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documentation supports the Outlook experience, licensing, defaults and both documented control routes. One minor correction remains: the checklist asks administrators to check Integrated apps, but that check has no corresponding controls-table row.
